title: SUX (sac's Utilities)
description: Small utilities via datapacking like common utility clients/mods but in a vanilla way
body:
# SUX stands for sac's Utilities/X
And is a little collection of utilities that can be accessed through simple /trigger commands.

This is serversided meaning u can use it in singleplayer or on a server that u have access to changing making it all fair for evrey1 one not being client sided and all :D
